nodes.label: apple-touch-icon.png (Boxy iOS home-screen icon)
nodes.rationale: Square 180px icon: bold white sans-serif letter 'B' centered on a flat solid green background. Used as the Apple touch icon when the Boxy PWA is added to an iOS/Android home screen; linked from index.html via <link rel="apple-touch-icon"> and listed in vite-plugin-pwa includeAssets so the service worker precaches it.

nodes.label: Boxy brand mark (white B on green)
nodes.rationale: Minimal monogram identity for the Boxy SaaS product (not the Crotone demo tenant): a single letter on a flat color square, legible at small icon sizes and simple to regenerate programmatically (icons are generated with PHP GD per project notes).
